description: Restore an earlier remote artifact version as a new current version, keeping the address and history. Use when the user explicitly wants to undo a publication/update. Get version IDs with get_site include:[versions]. This changes current contents; establish the user's intended version before calling. Returns the new version identifier.

share_token.description: Token from a user-provided share URL; carries only that share permission.

slug.description: Artifact identifier returned by find/publish, or the slug in its /s/ URL. Not a local path.

tenant_id.description: Destination tenant for creation; defaults to the account tenant.

version_id.description: Historical version to restore, from get_site with versions included.

name: artifact_site_rollback
title: Roll back a site
